title: Add CLI pipeline orchestration gate

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Official docs for Python subprocess, Node child_process, Bash pipelines, and OWASP command injection were checked.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap and mode selection
phases.bottleneck_notes: Memory bootstrap and governance mode selection were fast.

phases.label: Requirements and spec records
phases.bottleneck_notes: Governance work required paired KO/EN requirements, spec, plan, tasks, validation, and traceability records.

phases.label: Validator, CLI, config, docs, and tests
phases.bottleneck_notes: Largest phase because it touched validator code, CLI command, evaluator condition, work mode registry, memory bootstrap, persistent instructions, router, index, workflow, prompt, and docs.

phases.label: Automated verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Unit tests, pipeline template check, work-mode drift check, config checks, audits, generated maps, and final evaluator were run.

phases.label: Evaluation and close-out records
phases.bottleneck_notes: Omission, resource, grounding, final evaluation, request trace, and work summary records were created.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Will be completed after final verification.

bottleneck_notes: The implementation phase is the bottleneck because this is a cross-cutting governance change with code, config, workflow, prompt, memory, and evaluator updates.
Future similar work could be faster if a generator creates paired KO/EN governance artifacts from one structured input.
